name: photo browser
fits: An app to look at the photos on the box: the folders, USB drives and NAS shares added in Music's sources. Browsing, a slideshow, photos by folder or by date. It only reads them, through the app kit, and needs nothing from the internet.

steps.does: Work out the photo browser from the request and write it down in DESIGN.md: its screens (the sources, a source's folders, a grid of photos, one photo full screen, a slideshow if asked), how the arrows and ok move through them, what Back does on each (back up a screen, and leave from the first), what a gamepad adds, and how it looks at couch distance on a 1920 x 1080 TV. The photos come only from agentv.photos: sources(), list() a page at a time, and url() at the width shown. Keep it to one page.

Write the photo browser, starting from the template in app/. Set tv.media to ["photos"] in app/manifest.json, and nothing else it doesn't need. Ask for photos at the width you show them (a grid's at 400 or so, full screen at 1920), a page at a time, and keep only what's on screen. Input comes from agentv.input.on, Back from agentv.onBack, Home's pause from agentv.onPause, and it calls agentv.ready() once something is drawn. Show a plain line when there are no sources or no photos. No inline scripts, eval or code from other sites. Run check until it passes.

Write tests in tests/ for what was asked: that the arrows and ok go from the sources to a folder to a photo, that Back comes back up, and that a photo is shown at the size it's drawn. The test run gives the app a source with a few photos. Use the test API the tests reference describes, and run them with run_tests.

Run AgenTV's checks with try and the tests with run_tests, and fix what they find, until both pass: it opens, answers the remote and a gamepad, Back leaves it, it keeps 60 frames a second within its memory, and it asks for nothing from the internet.
